deferred_grafts.ir_rule: The owners author all five in their slices exactly as the BRD states. The IR is the final state, and the K-OFF dry run compiles it. Nothing is held out of the IR.
engine_handling: PASS 1 creates every flow shell (and list) before any body, so all four flow ids exist first. A Reference or aggregate that points at an existing shell is not treated as dangling (master.md §4.11; workspace engine tools/kissflow-app-agents-1.6.0/engine/client.mjs L286-L287 and L492-L516).

The compiler emits Open_Count inline in the Case body: LHSModel is Register's id, the Criteria is Register_Case EQUAL_TO _id, and the AggregateField is Open_Lines (1.6.0 builders.mjs, aggregate.match). App Builder 1.0.0 internals were not inspected; the K-OFF dry run confirms its compile.

PASS 2 writes and publishes each flow body with no dependency sort and no deferral of back-pointing aggregates (1.6.0 runs it 4-wide in parallel). The materialized forms[] order is not the build order either: it is alphabetical, and runs/ciq-digital passed verify with CIQ Case listed before the flows it references.

So the engine does NOT itself place Open_Count after Register. Whether Kissflow accepts Case's publish before Register's fields are published is unproven (K-OFF compile; K-20/K-PC runtime). A refused body publish is reported, that flow stays an unpublished draft, and the apply continues.
procedure: Read back CIQ ZZ Spike Case (draft and published) and CIQ ZZ Spike Register.
(a) Case is published with Open_Count wired to Register (Open_Lines, Register_Case) and all four other G1 items present: G1 is done, with no graft.
(b) Case's publish was refused and it is still an unpublished draft: publish Case again now that Register exists. A draft is not frozen.

(c) Case is published but a G1 item is missing or unwired: graft only the missing items onto the published Case. Hold_Flag and Gate use kf patch add-field --formula (it adds the per-step permissions). The condition uses kf patch condition, and the Mandatory uses kf patch step-permission. Open_Count needs a bespoke draft graft (kf patch has no aggregate verb) plus one step Permission per Case step. Then read back.
deferred_grafts.risk: Path (c) edits a published Process. LESSONS 1b says that is refused (PUT draft 403); master.md §196 says well-formed grafts work and to re-verify on the tenant. If the graft is refused, the harness Case lacks the gate and K-20/K-PC cannot run on it: report that to Thomas. Do not rename flows or add flows or fields.
deferred_grafts.transfer: The real app uses the same pattern: Form header counts with a Reference to CIQ Case feed blank-safe holds and gates (app-plan-v4 §7, K-20/K-20F). So the path G1 takes, (a), (b) or (c), tells the real generate whether one pass is enough.

hard_rules.rule: The harness is exactly: 4 flows (Processes CIQ ZZ Spike Case and CIQ ZZ Spike Point; Forms CIQ ZZ Spike Register and CIQ ZZ Spike Log), 3 embedded child tables (Spike Case Notes, Spike Rounds, Spike Lines), 1 Reference (Register.Register_Case to Case), 2 lists, 2 custom roles plus Admin and User reused. Add nothing. Child tables are embedded models, not account-level flows, so their BRD names need no CIQ ZZ Spike prefix.

Step names, order, owners and conditions exactly as in id_reservations.step_prefix_by_flow, with the en-dash U+2013. First and last steps are unconditioned. The block is one Parallel step with six single-step branches, each conditioned on its own Flag_X = "Yes", auto-joining before "Spike hold check". Each branch edits only its own lane fields, and Lane_X_Confirm is Mandatory there. Spike Case Notes is editable only at "Spike prepare" and Spike Rounds only at "Spike review". Response_Text is editable at "Spike waiting".

Field names verbatim from the BRD; never author Name. Register_Key required; Register_Case is a non-required Reference to CIQ ZZ Spike Case (OQ-09). Open_Lines is an embedded-child SUM of Spike Lines.Line_Open. Open_Count, Hold_Flag and Gate are authored exactly as the BRD states and tagged G1. The two lists use the reserved ids without _A00.

Role A and Role B are Editable on all four flows; no grants to Admin or User; no members. Name the trade-off: Editable on a Process grants InitiateItems and a StartEvent carries no actor restriction, so Role B can also create Cases and Points although the BRD names Role A at Start (LESSONS 18).
pages = [], no nav, no cards, no custom UI. The generate must pass --no-pages.
automations = []. The test integrations are created separately, outside the IR. CIQ ZZ Spike Log is a plain target Form; Log_Item_Id stays Text (TK01).

domain.summary: Throwaway test harness "zz-spike" for CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00), approved by Thomas on 2026-10-07. Four flows prove Kissflow behaviours before the real app is generated: Process "CIQ ZZ Spike Case" (Start, prepare, a 6-branch PARALLEL block with flag conditions and branch-scoped lane fields, a formula-conditioned hold check, a step with a Mandatory formula gate, and a not-equal condition step); Process "CIQ ZZ Spike Point" (Start, a Select-conditioned waiting step, a review step with a step-scoped child table); Form "CIQ ZZ Spike Register" (child table with a header SUM, referencing a case, feeding the case's cross-flow SUM Open_Count); Form "CIQ ZZ Spike Log" (target for separately created integration tests). Two roles (A, B), both Editable on all four flows, no members. Two lists. No pages, nav, UI or automations in the IR. Extracted exactly as specified; nothing added.

journeys.name: Run a spike case end to end
journeys.trigger: A tester starts a test of the parallel, formula-condition and gate behaviours
steps: Role A creates the case at "Create spike case"
Role A sets Flag_A–Flag_F and Spike_Decision (default placement, OQ-02/OQ-03) and the "Spike Case Notes" rows (stated) at "Spike prepare"
The PARALLEL block runs the branches whose Flag_X = "Yes"; each branch owner fills only its own lane fields (Lane_X_Confirm is Mandatory); branches A, C, E belong to Role A and B, D, F to Role B
After the join, "Spike hold check" (Role A) runs only when Hold_Flag = "Yes" (Open_Count blank or not 0)
"Spike gated step" (Role A) can only be submitted when Gate = "OK", i.e. Open_Count is blank or 0
"Spike not-equal step" (Role B) runs only when Spike_Decision != "Rejected"
journeys.outcome: The case reaches End along the path the flags, Hold_Flag, Gate and Spike_Decision dictate
success_criteria: Unflagged branches are skipped and the join still completes
A branch cannot edit another lane
A branch cannot submit without its Lane_X_Confirm
Hold check runs exactly when Hold_Flag = "Yes"
Gated step refuses submit while Gate is blank
Not-equal step is skipped when Spike_Decision = "Rejected"

journeys.name: Run a spike point end to end
journeys.trigger: A tester raises a spike point
steps: Role A raises the point at "Raise spike point" and sets To_Supplier and the scalar fields (default placement, OQ-05)
"Spike waiting" (Role A) runs only when To_Supplier = "Yes"; Response_Text is Editable there
"Spike review" (Role B); the "Spike Rounds" child table is editable only here
journeys.outcome: The point reaches End, with or without the waiting step
success_criteria: Waiting step is skipped when To_Supplier is not "Yes"

business_rules.statement: Every flow, list and role name starts with "CIQ ZZ Spike".
Keep the harness minimal and exactly as specified; it is a throwaway test harness, not a business app.
After "Spike prepare", CIQ ZZ Spike Case runs a PARALLEL block of 6 branches "Spike review – A" … "Spike review – F", owned alternately by Role A and Role B, and joins before "Spike hold check".
Each branch "Spike review – X" runs only when its own Select flag Flag_X = "Yes" (list "CIQ ZZ Spike Yes No").
Each branch edits ONLY its own lane fields Lane_X_Confirm, Lane_X_By, Lane_X_At, Lane_X_Note; Lane_X_Confirm is Mandatory there.
"Spike hold check" (Role A) runs after the join only when Hold_Flag = "Yes".
Hold_Flag is a formula Text field: IF(ISBLANK(Open_Count),"Yes",IF(Open_Count=0,"No","Yes")).
Open_Count is a cross-flow SUM aggregate of "CIQ ZZ Spike Register".Open_Lines over the registers whose Reference Register_Case = this case.
Gate is a formula field IF(IF(ISBLANK(Open_Count),0,Open_Count)=0,"OK","") and is Mandatory at "Spike gated step" (Role A).
"Spike not-equal step" (Role B) runs only when Spike_Decision != "Rejected" (Select, list "CIQ ZZ Spike Decision": Approved, Rejected).
Child table "Spike Case Notes" (Note_Text, Note_By) is editable only at "Spike prepare".
"Spike waiting" (Role A) runs only when To_Supplier = "Yes" (a Select).
Response_Text is Editable at "Spike waiting".
Child table "Spike Rounds" (Round_No, Question, Response, Outcome) is editable only at "Spike review".
Register_Key is required on CIQ ZZ Spike Register.
Open_Lines is a header aggregate = SUM of "Spike Lines".Line_Open.
CIQ ZZ Spike Log is the target of the integration tests; those integrations are created separately and are not in the IR.
Roles CIQ ZZ Spike Role A and CIQ ZZ Spike Role B have no members; Thomas adds the people.
Role A and Role B are Editable on all four flows.
No pages, no nav, no UI.
No automations in the IR.

security.legend: field_permissions[flow][stepId][fieldId|childTableId] = Editable|ReadOnly|Hidden|Mandatory. Every header field and the child table are keyed explicitly at every task step; child-column ids are not accepted as step keys (D12).

data_scope.rule: Test harness: both custom roles read all records of all four flows (brd L57). Default roles Admin and User get no grants. Views/dashboards: none (no pages).

satisfiability.note: Derived from executable grants: initiator:true only for Role A on both Processes; first step owner (SPKC_S0, SPKP_S0) is Role A. Each task step has exactly its workflow assignee as Act.

residual_risks: SPKC_PAR (container) and End steps carry no field_permissions keys: they are not user tasks.

steps.name: Spike review lanes
steps.note: Container. BRD names no block step; the engine requires a name (validate STEP_NO_NAME at r4), so 'Spike review lanes' is a container label only. One-level fork, auto-join before SPKC_S3.

journey_scenarios.intent: All six flags Yes: every branch runs and joins; no register so Open_Count blank -> Hold_Flag Yes (hold check runs), Gate OK; Approved -> not-equal step runs.
Only Flag_A and Flag_B Yes: C-F skipped, join still completes; Rejected -> not-equal step skipped.
Role B attempts branch A (Role A's lane).
To_Supplier Yes: waiting step runs, then review edits Spike Rounds.
Role A attempts Role B's review.

meta.contract: Step ids/names/owners/conditions byte-exact per architecture.id_reservations.step_prefix_by_flow; en-dash U+2013.
meta.parallel_container: SPKC_PAR named 'Spike review lanes' because validate rejects a nameless step (STEP_NO_NAME). Label only; no owner, no condition.
meta.sla_note: No durations stated in brd; slas = [] and notifications = [] by design (test harness).

security_handoff.note: Per-step field permissions are kf-security-designer's (security.field_permissions[flow][stepId][field], the engine convention used in run ciq-digital). Unlisted fields ReadOnly at each step. Initiator: Role A on both Processes (initiator:true); Act per step owner.

items.note: OQ-06: no editable fields; initiator Role A
